archetypes.name: ledger-routing
archetypes.rationale: Token sidecar routing crosses env precedence and tmpdir boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the lint-fix and research token ingestion paths for ledger routing correctness. Focus on stale environment variables, tmpdir precedence, non-zero launcher exits, and duplicate active-ledger writes Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: warning-surface
archetypes.rationale: The change intentionally surfaces failures without failing parent flows.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review operator-visible warning behavior for copy failures, unsupported TOOL values, and token subprocess failures. Check that warnings preserve useful stderr while keeping existing launcher and lint-fix status semantics Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
